graph.title: Ganjave et al. (2022) cybernetic fed-batch culture
graph.description: One instance of the Ganjave growth model, integrated over 24 h in fed-batch mode on the feed recipe the paper reports as its selected optimum (17.5 % w/v glycerol, 24.5 % w/v yeast extract, 0.72 mL/h from 6 h). The three initial conditions the paper does not state are declared here as literals, because the model requires them and the adapter will not invent a default.
graph.source_ref: Ganjave et al. 2022, Biotechnology Reports 33:e00694, doi:10.1016/j.btre.2021.e00694
graph.notes: This graph runs the model; it does not reproduce the paper. The published time courses are figures, no figure was digitised, and the model's reproduction status is not_yet_validated. The three declared initial values are assumptions of this graph, not measurements from the paper.

assumptions: feed_complex_substrate_concentration: The upstream stream must be the nitrogen-rich feed on this model's lumped basis.

feed_flow_rate: The upstream flow must be a liquid volumetric rate into this culture. A gas flow, or a per-minute rate, is a unit question rather than a meaning question and is converted; a *mass* flow is a different quantity and is refused.
feed_glycerol_concentration: The upstream stream must be the glycerol feed. A culture glycerol concentration shares the unit and the quantity but is a different physical stream.
feed_start_time: The same clock as this run's integration interval.

initial_complex_substrate_concentration: The upstream value must be a nitrogen-rich complex substrate on this model's lumped basis, with a comparable fitted yield. A defined medium component (say a single amino acid) is not interchangeable with a lumped mixture the paper fitted as one number, and the model has no component identity to check it against.

assumptions.summary: Table 2 prints the initial enzyme ratio for combination 2 as 'e20/em1'; the denominator of combination 2 must be e_m2. Read as e2(0)/e_m2 = 0.874.
X0, S2_0 and DO0 are not stated in the paper and are supplied by the caller. S2_0 in particular decides whether the culture becomes oxygen-limited.
The published time courses are figures. No numerical observations were recoverable, so no trajectory here has been compared against a measured point.

limitations.source: the model's own manifest, as published through --describe-model

combined_graph.basis: Composing these models produces a system that no published source has evaluated. Validation evidence for an individual model is a statement about that model and does not transfer to the composition, so the combined graph starts from 'not established' and can only be changed by an independent evaluation.
combined_graph.execution_is_not_validation: A successful execution is evidence that the pipeline works. It is not evidence that the numbers are right, and nothing in this report upgrades a model's reproduction_status because a test passed.
